finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. Threw `TypeError` on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) treated an unset flag as invalid instead of `false`, so `isBackoffEnabled({})` threw.

The rest were deprecation noise, harmless.

Next: nothing. Build passes clean.
